LESSON: WHOLE NUMBERS

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade two
Subject: General
Strand: NUMBERS
Topic 1.2: Whole Numbers
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 20

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Whole Numbers, part of NUMBERS in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade two General.

Key inquiry question: How do we get the next number in a number pattern?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Whole Numbers together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Values:
• Respect: Learners understand and appreciate others' ideas and value the input of their peers as they work in pairs taking turns to

read and write numbers 1-100 in words using number cards.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

• Health promotion: Learners in pairs or in groups take care of each other as they count forward in 1’s, 10’s, and 100’s starting from

any point up to 1000 using rope skipping game.

Link to other learning areas:

• Learners relate skills for rhyme singing in counting to Creative activities.

Suggested Learning resources:

● A number line drawn on the ground/floor, place value chart, a rope, number cards
